sourceCorrection: 动作很僵硬、没有全身协调/关节限制；至少有好的效果再给我看。
failureMechanism: A motion can complete the nominal task and pass component/binding checks while still containing foot skating, floating or penetration, jerk spikes, joint-limit violations, mistimed contacts, or a frozen torso/limb response. Playback success is therefore not evidence of coordinated natural motion.
preconditions: binding and self-penetration compatibility gate passes
taskAnchorRequired: required observer views and held-out environment perturbations
deliveryReceiptRequired: phase-local foot-skate, ground-penetration, floating, jerk and joint-limit reports
contact timing and whole-body participation reports
negative-control results and exact artifact/runtime provenance
candidatePassRule: All prerequisites pass; every phase-local metric remains within a frozen action-specific envelope derived from a legitimate reference on the same skeleton/body class; all negative controls are rejected; an independent verifier accepts a multi-view rollout and small held-out environment perturbations.
hardReject: generic third-party thresholds used as KAOPU acceptance criteria
task-complete clip with any critical contact, joint-limit, penetration or coordination violation
single beauty view without per-frame traces
smooth but low-participation root-only or frozen-upper-body motion
boundaries: Metric pass is not USER-ACCEPTED and does not prove perceptual naturalness.
Whole-body participation is action-specific; low motion can be correct for some phases.
Thresholds must be calibrated per action and skeleton/body class, not copied from research defaults.
This candidate does not replace task/environment, component identity, binding, self-collision, or user acceptance gates.
